# Teaser vs give everything

**Does the reel give the whole thing, or hold some back?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C11


## Give everything, right here
<a id="give-everything"></a>

The full answer is in the video. 'Share the knowledge, sell the execution.'

**Looks like:** Every step is shown, with a 'take a picture' pause on the full map at the end. Nothing is held for DMs.

**Good at:** trust; saves; goodwill; stands out from DM funnels

**Weak at:** fewer comments; no lead capture

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, carousel, yt-long · niches all · goals trust, saves · effort medium

**How:** Hold the final summary frame for 2–3 s. Say 'everything is here, no DM needed'.

**Backed by:** [Share the knowledge, sell the execution](../topics/business.md#biz-share-knowledge-sell-execution), [Anti-CTA: no DM needed, it's all here](../topics/growth.md#growth-anti-cta), ["Take a picture" save moment](../topics/growth.md#growth-screenshot-save-moment), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall), [Show the comment → DM funnel on screen](../topics/growth.md#growth-show-the-funnel) · sources L05, L04, L08

## Show part, comment for the rest
<a id="withhold-remainder"></a>

Show some of the list or answer, then 'comment X for the rest'.

**Looks like:** Six CPUs rated, then the full tier list flashes for half a second. 'Comment CPU for the full list.'

**Good at:** comments; DM leads; rewatches to catch the flash

**Weak at:** can feel withholding; lower trust if overused

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90 · niches tech, gym · goals comments, sales · effort low

**How:** End on a fast flash of the full asset plus a keyword label. Deliver it by DM.

**Backed by:** [Withhold the rest: "comment for the rest"](../topics/growth.md#growth-withheld-remainder), [Show the comment → DM funnel on screen](../topics/growth.md#growth-show-the-funnel), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall), [Pick one goal: comments, sends or saves](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-conversation-goal), [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta) · sources R1

## Give it all, DM the extra
<a id="give-all-plus-extra"></a>

The video explains everything; the DM gives a bonus (exact settings, a file, styling).

**Looks like:** Every step is explained on screen. The CTA: 'Comment EDIT and I'll send the exact styling I used.' Nobody feels cheated and the comments still come.

**Good at:** comments and trust together; lead capture; no 'teaser' resentment

**Weak at:** needs a real bonus asset; more work per reel

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gym · goals comments, trust · effort medium

**How:** Prepare the bonus (preset, PDF, link list) before posting. The keyword is shown on screen at the end.

**Backed by:** [Undercut a paid course in the hook](../topics/hooks.md#l10-undercut-paid-hook), [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta), [Show the comment → DM funnel on screen](../topics/growth.md#growth-show-the-funnel), [Anti-CTA: no DM needed, it's all here](../topics/growth.md#growth-anti-cta), [Lead-magnet CTA over a recap strip](../topics/growth.md#l11-lead-magnet-recap-cta) · sources L10, R1

## Hyper-edited teaser for a long piece
<a id="teaser-for-long"></a>

A 30–45 s cut of the most contrarian soundbite, sending people to the full video.

**Looks like:** Black screen, glowing text, then the guest's wildest line, shots under 2 s, bass hits on text pops, a thud and a cut to black. 'Full episode on YouTube.'

**Good at:** drives long-form views; reach; reuses existing footage

**Weak at:** needs a long piece behind it; the teaser can overpromise

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals reach, retention · effort medium

**How:** Pull one soundbite, cut on percussive hits in CapCut, and add push-ins and a glow on the text.

**Backed by:** [Sell a long video with a hyper-edited teaser](../topics/editing.md#edit-teaser-hyper-edited), [Cold open with later highlights](../topics/hooks.md#hook-cold-open-montage), [Context in the first words, three channels](../topics/hooks.md#hook-context-first-words), [End on a thud and cut to black](../topics/transitions.md#tr-cut-to-black-thud) · sources L08

## Mixing
Give-all-plus-extra sits between both sides. A teaser for a long piece is the one case where holding back is the whole point.

## Rule of thumb
Trust and saves: give everything. Comments and leads: withhold or extra. Long-form traffic: teaser.
